note: Suzuki's diesels were all recorded as petrol: the Fiat-built 1.3 DDiS (Z13DT, D13A), the PSA XUD9 in the Vitara (DHW), and the PSA HDi units in the Grand Vitara. Suzuki's modern K-series petrols are specified 0W-20; the G and F series take a conventional grade suited to hot climates. Capacities are family figures unless stated otherwise.

engines.source: 1.3 DDiS (Z13DT, D13A) — the Fiat-built Multijet fitted to the Swift, Ignis and SX4. Particulate filter fitted on the later builds. Recorded as petrol.
DHW is PSA's XUD9SD, fitted to the Suzuki Vitara — the same engine and the same 4.75 L figure used in the PSA table. Recorded as petrol.
PSA DW10 HDi units fitted to the Grand Vitara, and the Renault F9Q in some markets. Recorded as petrol.
K-series / Boosterjet (K10B, K12C Dualjet, K14C, K15B) — Swift, Baleno, Vitara, Ignis, S-Cross, Jimny. Suzuki specifies 0W-20 for these; a heavier grade is withheld deliberately.
M-series 1.3-1.8 (M13A, M15A, M16A, M18A) — Swift, Liana, SX4, Jimny, Grand Vitara.
J-series and H-series V6 (J18A, J20A, J24B, H20A, H25A, H27A) — Grand Vitara, Vitara, XL-7.
G-series 1.0-1.6 (G10A, G13A/B/BA/BB, G16A/B) — Swift, Baleno, Vitara, Jimny, Wagon R. Very common older Suzuki in Tunisia.
F-series 0.8/1.0 (F8A, F8B, F10A, F6A) — SJ410, Samurai, Alto, Maruti. Small sump; 10W-40 suits hot climates.
